coverageNotes: Chains research (round 1, 2026-10-13). Kenya has very few true multi-branch gym chains, and search engines index them poorly. Small-gym searches mostly returned hotel/Airbnb pages or generic directories. CONFIRMED FROM OFFICIAL SITES: SmartGyms (official list now 3 Nairobi clubs: Junction, Diamond Plaza, The Hub Karen. The Southfield Mall branch appears in 2025 blogs/directories but no longer on the official site, so status unknown). AFROFIT (3 clubs: Delta Chambers Westlands, Thika Road Mall 2nd floor, United Mall Kisumu 1st floor. The Malindi club from 2024 is no longer listed). Natty Gyms (Kahawa Sukari already in seed, plus Ruiru and Membley without street addresses; Kenyatta Road coming soon). Fitness 16 (Juja open; Ruaka coming soon). Legacy Fitness, Mombasa (Mwembe Tayari main gym already in seed with a dead website; Bamburi Mwisho and Bombolulu Petrocity branches are new. The new site carries spam, so treat it with care). Hotel-chain gyms with official pages: PrideInn (Uzima Gym at Paradise Shanzu and Azure Westlands; fitness centre at Plaza, Athi River), Serena Beach Mombasa (Maisha Health Club), Hemingways Nairobi and Watamu. Wadi Degla Runda is included with status unknown (2016 evidence only). easyGym Kenya (seed) is flagged because its website no longer resolves. SINGLE-SITE, NOT CHAINS (checked and skipped): Platinum Fitness (Kenya Cinema Plaza), Muscle Health & Fitness (site lists only Vision Plaza), SmashFit (Sarit only), InShape (Mombasa CBD only), Colosseum, Feel Fitness, Alpha Fit, The Burn Club, F45 (only the Lavington studio in Kenya; covered by nbo-westlands), VMX. NOT FOUND IN KENYA: Curves, Anytime Fitness, Gold's Gym, Snap Fitness, Gracie Barra. UNVERIFIED: Faiz Gym Nyali, Physiq & Tone Westlands, Racing Sport's 2 branches, Ignite Fitness (likely defunct). BLOCKED: sarovahotels.com, radissonhotels.com and marriott.com returned 403, so Sarova, Radisson and Marriott gyms are not recorded. No evidenced multi-branch gym chain was found outside Nairobi/Kiambu, Mombasa and Kisumu (searches covered Nakuru, Eldoret, Kisumu, Thika, Nyeri, Meru, Embu, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kisii, Kitengela, Syokimau and Mlolongo). No branch coordinates were taken from maps, so geocoding is still needed. Queries 1-12 of this list were reconstructed after a shared scratch file was overwritten by another agent; the queries themselves were run.
